karty.priklad: Maen nhw'n ddiddorol! Tipyn o gamp!
karty.priklad_cs: They're interesting! Quite an achievement! (camp → [g]amp after o)
karty.mnemo: Surviving a week CAMPing (CAMP) on a slope of red lava – now that's an achievement!

karty.priklad: Welais i mo'r arwydd, a welais i mo'r gyffordd chwaith.
karty.priklad_cs: I didn't see the sign, and I didn't see the junction either (cyffordd → [g]yffordd after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: cy- + ffordd (road): the place where roads meet – and a red double-decker bus is stuck right in the middle of it.

karty.priklad: Mae dawn gyda ti! Dylet ti fynd ar Noson Lawen!
karty.priklad_cs: You've got talent! You should go on Noson Lawen!
karty.mnemo: Like English DAWN: a talent shows itself like a blazing red sunrise.

sever.priklad: Mae gen ti ddawn! Dylet ti fynd ar Noson Lawen!
sever.priklad_cs: You've got talent! You should go on Noson Lawen!
sever.pozn: north: gen ti instead of gyda ti (L6), soft mutation after gen: dawn → [dd]awn

karty.priklad: Pam croesoch chi'r lôn feicio mor gyflym a chodi ofn ar y plant?
karty.priklad_cs: Why did you cross the bike lane so fast and frighten the children? (cyflym → [g]yflym after mor; codi → [ch]odi after a)
karty.mnemo: lôn (lane) + beicio (cycling): a bike lane painted chilli red. feicio is always mutated in this fixed phrase, after the feminine lôn.

karty.priklad: Prynais i'r hen gadair mewn ocsiwn.
karty.priklad_cs: I bought the old chair at an auction (cadair → [g]adair after hen).
karty.mnemo: AUCTION → OCSIWN: going, going… sold, to the bidder waving a red paddle.

extra.pozn: own example (only in the Geirfa in this unit)

karty.priklad: Mae Siop Lyfrau'r Aber wrth ymyl yr aber.
karty.priklad_cs: The Estuary Bookshop is right by the estuary (siop lyfrau: llyfrau → [l]yfrau after the feminine siop).
karty.mnemo: Aber- in place names: Aberystwyth = mouth of the Ystwyth, Abertawe (Swansea) = mouth of the Tawe – where the river runs into the icy sea.

extra.pozn: the shop name is from the coursebook (p. 84), the sentence is my own

karty.priklad: Tipyn o gamp! Pwy yw'r artist talentog?
karty.priklad_cs: Quite an achievement! Who's the talented artist?
karty.mnemo: Same as English: an artist painting an iceberg.

sever.priklad: Tipyn o gamp! Pwy ydy'r artist talentog?
sever.priklad_cs: Quite an achievement! Who's the talented artist?
sever.pozn: north: Pwy ydy instead of Pwy yw (like Beth yw / Be ydy, L5)

karty.priklad: Pam wnaethoch chi ddim troi wrth yr arwydd?
karty.priklad_cs: Why didn't you turn at the sign?
karty.mnemo: 'ARE WE THERE?' (AR-WYDD) – check the sign, half buried in snow.

karty.priklad: Dw i wedi rhoi'r parti ar y calendr yn y gegin.
karty.priklad_cs: I've put the party on the calendar in the kitchen (cegin → [g]egin after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: Same as English: a calendar stuck on January, frozen in time.

extra.pozn: own example (only in the Geirfa in this unit)

karty.priklad: Welais i mo'r camera cyflymder wrth yrru bant ar frys!
karty.priklad_cs: I didn't see the speed camera as I drove off in a hurry! (gyrru → [y]rru after wrth; brys → [f]rys after ar)
karty.mnemo: cyflym (fast) + -der (noun ending) = speed: the speed camera flashes a cold blue light.

sever.priklad: Welais i mo'r camera cyflymder wrth yrru i ffwrdd ar frys!
sever.priklad_cs: I didn't see the speed camera as I drove off in a hurry! (gyrru → [y]rru after wrth; brys → [f]rys after ar)
sever.pozn: north: i ffwrdd instead of bant (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Yn ôl y chwedl, roedd cawr yn byw ar ben y mynydd.
karty.priklad_cs: According to the legend, a giant lived on top of the mountain.
karty.mnemo: Villagers COWER (CAWR) below the giant – a glacier that has come to life.

extra.pozn: cawres = giantess; own example (only in the Geirfa in this unit)

karty.priklad: Chlywais i mo'r cyfarwyddiadau gan y warden.
karty.priklad_cs: I didn't hear the instructions from the warden (clywed → [ch]lywais in the negative).
karty.mnemo: cyfarwydd = familiar: instructions make a task familiar – read them before you step onto the ice.

karty.priklad: Colloch chi o ddeg gôl i ddim! Does dim egni yn eich gêm chi.
karty.priklad_cs: You lost ten nil! There's no energy in your game (deg → [dd]eg after o).
karty.mnemo: An EGG-NEE (EG-ni) a day gives you energy for a run through the snow.

extra.pozn: ynni (L16) = energy in the sense of electricity, fuel

karty.priklad: Maen nhw'n gwadu bydd etholiad yn fuan.
karty.priklad_cs: They deny there'll be an election soon.
karty.mnemo: ethol = to elect: 'ETHEL I'D (ETH-OL-iad) vote for!' – Ethel wins the election in a snowstorm.

karty.priklad: Dylai anifeiliaid gael gofal da yn y llety.
karty.priklad_cs: Animals should get good care in the boarding kennels (cael → [g]ael after dylai).
karty.mnemo: Take care, or you'll GO and FALL (GO-FAL) on the ice!

karty.priklad: Pwy dorrodd y ffenest? Dw i eisiau'r gwirionedd.
karty.priklad_cs: Who broke the window? I want the truth (torri → [d]orrodd after pwy).
karty.mnemo: gwir (true) + -ionedd: the truth – cold and clear as a frozen pond.

sever.priklad: Pwy dorrodd y ffenest? Dw i isio'r gwirionedd.
sever.priklad_cs: Who broke the window? I want the truth.

karty.priklad: Weithiau, roedden nhw'n mynd â'r gath i lety yn agos i Gaerdydd.
karty.priklad_cs: Sometimes they took the cat to a cattery near Cardiff (llety → [l]ety, Caerdydd → [G]aerdydd after i).
karty.mnemo: Memory aid: lle (place) + tŷ (house) = a place to sleep – even an igloo will do.

extra.pozn: the etymology is disputed (lle + tŷ, or lled- + tŷ)

karty.priklad: Pam dych chi yn y llys heddiw, felly?
karty.priklad_cs: So why are you in court today?
karty.mnemo: In court, the judge reads out the LEASE (LLYS) on a polar bear's frozen den.

sever.priklad: Pam dach chi yn y llys heddiw, felly?
sever.priklad_cs: So why are you in court today?
sever.pozn: north: dach chi instead of dych chi (L11)

karty.priklad: Mae sgiliau gwahanol gan bawb.
karty.priklad_cs: Everyone has different skills (pawb → [b]awb after gan).
karty.mnemo: Same as English SKILL: the skill of skating backwards on a frozen lake.

karty.priklad: Helô, helô, helô. Ro'ch chi'n gyrru wyth deg milltir yr awr, syr.
karty.priklad_cs: Hello, hello, hello. You were driving at eighty miles an hour, sir.
karty.mnemo: Same as English: 'Yes, sir!' from a sentry frozen at his post.

karty.priklad: Cyrhaeddon ni'r targed eleni.
karty.priklad_cs: We hit the target this year.
karty.mnemo: TARGET (TARG-ed): a blue bull's-eye painted on the ice.

extra.pozn: own example (only in the Geirfa in this unit)

karty.priklad: Beth yw testun y traethawd?
karty.priklad_cs: What's the subject of the essay?
karty.mnemo: TEST-un: the topic of today's TEST, chalked on a frosty blackboard.

extra.pozn: own example (only in the Geirfa in this unit); pwnc = school subject

sever.priklad_cs: What's the subject of the essay?
sever.pozn: north: Be ydy instead of Beth yw (L5)
